answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, but correlated equivocation links their signed conflicts into one event: when k identities coordinate, the penalty grows as O(k^2), rather than linearly, rapidly exhausting shared backing. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the sybil controller, while asymmetric depreciation prevents full recovery. Thus even a grove, yarrow, or pigment-themed swarm remains economically irrational.
